notes: Recorded 70 master's programmes from the nine colleges, plus 36 rows for the majors or specializations that the programme pages name inside some programmes (106 rows in all). The Deanship's list has 115 postgraduate entries in total: 70 master's programmes, 42 PhD programmes and 3 postgraduate diplomas (Marine Science and Fisheries, Crop Production, Crop Protection); PhD programmes and diplomas are not recorded because the scholarship is for the Master's level.

Programmes per college: College of Agricultural and Marine Science 8; College of Arts and Social Sciences 10; College of Economic and Political Science 6; College of Education 12; College of Engineering 11; College of Law 4; College of Medicine and Health Sciences 7; College of Nursing 2; College of Science 10.

The scholarship is full-time only, so part-time-only programmes (for example MSc in Operation and Supply Chain Management and MSc in Accounting and Finance) are listed by the Deanship but cannot be taken on this scholarship.

The list comes from the Deanship's program listing for the current page version; one programme (MSc in Pure Mathematics) appears only on the College of Science page, not in the paged list, so both views were combined.
Programme names are as printed, including the source's own spelling variants (for example 'Operation and Supply Chain Managment').
not_stated: Whether every listed programme is open for the 2027-2028 intake; admission and availability are decided per cycle.
